summary: Japanese motion designer describes using After Effects rough comps plus ChatGPT-made material images as MiniMax H3 references, iterating AE edits and prompt fixes to treat AI video as a render pass.
question_it_answers: How do you hand off After Effects rough comps and material stills into MiniMax H3?

claims.text: Workflow uses AE rough comps and GPT-generated material images as H3 references for generation and revision loops.
claims.evidence:
・AEでラフな同コンテを作成
・Chat GPTでマテリアルを作成
・H3でAEラフとマテリアル画像を参照
claims.subject: code-motion-graphics

recipe_steps: Create rough AE comps matching the intended motion.
Write and refine prompts, then run H3 with AE rough and material references.
Revise AE motion or regenerate materials based on output, looping prompt fixes.
title: After Effects rough comps as MiniMax H3 reference for AI video
